notes.title: A Review a Day Keeps the Escorting Career Away
notes.notes:
Hey everyone. Congrats on making it to today, otherwise known as a full week after THE GAME AWARDS launched. Life's hard, and reaching March 2024 is no small achievement. I'm proud of you.

But we're not here to talk about pride; we're here to talk about feedback. Those of you who've tried the game: What are your thoughts? Barring my, erm, not-so-adequately explained save system (Steam forums are no substitute for proper in-game labeling!), any big criticisms or questions you want to dole out?

Also, if you enjoyed any part of the experience, by all means, leave a review. Those things are a real PITA to secure and are the difference between Undertale-level success and an Eastern European developer losing his house because his tiny Steam game didn't secure enough rubles via Steam store exposure.

To note: I'm not Eastern European. That was just me punching down. Anyway, again, please review if you want to spread the word about TGA, hit me (hard, like the tramp I am) with any additional feedback here, and have a great day.
